authority: Owner 2026-10-28 item 1 and item 4 (thresholds unchanged), Owner 2026-10-30 third ruling item 6 (a STOP stops the release; no relaxed threshold, no new seeds, no scope change), stage1_formal_acceptance_registration_3aB.json step 1
ruleset: balanceTool.v21 (tool path: Director core.v1, laneFrame teamRelative, skills on, talents off, items standard, no player stats) — the plans themselves are compared, not the AI coach or player stats
templates: all 21 templates of TACTIC_TEMPLATE_LIST (8 classic, std, 12 v2), each as a tactic-book plan with no choices; std vs std is the control
opponent: std template plan with no choices

seeds.path: tool (seed as-is; tools/check_study_seed_plan_3aB.mjs, reserved block G-A8.fixConfirm)
seeds.side: the template plays blue on odd seeds and red on even seeds (200 / 200), so the map side cancels; layout by seed (report STANDARD/SWAPPED split)
seeds.rule: disjoint from the original G-A8 and knob seeds (25001-25400) and the screening seeds (41001-41400) that chose the values

metric: the template side's win rate; a match with no winner at 3600 s counts 0.5

thresholds.STOP (dominant): win rate >= 0.60 AND the lower 95% bound > 0.55
thresholds.WARN: win rate >= 0.57, or win rate <= 0.43 (a dominated plan is reported; it is not a release blocker by itself)
thresholds.control: std vs std must have a win rate within 0.50 +/- 0.05 (instrument sanity); outside => STOP(INSTRUMENT)

report: per template: win rate, 95% CI, as blue / as red, STANDARD / SWAPPED split
median match duration per template (20-40 min long-term target, report only)
notClaimed: no claim that a template is favourable; a STOP means a template must not ship as-is and goes to the Owner (no coefficient change without the Owner). A PASS here clears only G-A8 for the frozen stage-1 semantics; the Challenge side-bias STOP and the rest of the acceptance are separate, and templates combined with choices are not tested here (knownVerificationGaps)
errors: errored matches are never retried or replaced and are listed by seed; any errored match => at most INCONCLUSIVE; more than 1% errored => STOP(INSTRUMENT)
instrumentCheck: every record (live and at report time): balanceTool.v21, Director core.v1, laneFrame teamRelative, skills on, talents off; any failure => HALT / STOP(INSTRUMENT). Added for this registration: the knobs the engine holds at t = 0 equal the knobs the resolver gives under templateBalance
sideBalanceNote: odd seeds: template on blue; even seeds: on red. Because the layout is by seed, the template is on the dragon side in 201/400 = 50.25% of these seeds; the std vs std control absorbs a common side effect; each template's dragonSideShare is reported
checkpointing: per match (finer than the plan's 250-match batches)
scope: all 21 templates, not only the changed ones: every template is re-checked and a new STOP elsewhere cannot hide. No template is dropped after the fact
